summary.text: Macy Bolinske is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 40 (home city listed as Minot), serving since 2025 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Bolinske lists an occupation of Bookkeeper.
It lists education as BS, Psychology, UND.
Family is listed as: Married (Benjamin); 1 child.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Bolinske's standing committee assignments as Human Services and Political Subdivisions.
